installation.description: The installation whose recovery sign-in was turned off.

generation.description: The configuration's recovery.generation the disable covers. Recovery comes back only when the configuration names another one. Absent for the generation "".

sign_ins_ended.description: How many browser sign-ins made by recovery were ended with it.

sessions_ended.description: How many client sessions (refresh tokens) opened by those sign-ins were revoked with it.

repeat.description: True when the switch was already thrown and this call only ended recovery sessions it found.
